za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.source: That arrangement overlaps another image. Use a different edge or unplace the attached images first.

za/ui_that_arrangement_overlaps_another_.reason: Removes the invented requirement to unplace only from the edge; quotes Unplace and preserves the other-edge choice.

za/ui_give_all_images_the_same_each_imag.source: Give all %1$s images the same %2$s. Each image keeps its own aspect ratio. Original files and crop settings stay unchanged.

za/ui_monospace.reason: Qualifies every individual character, not the width of an entire text box.

za/ui_sans_light.reason: Describes relatively light strokes, not narrow characters.

za/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
za/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.previous:
Yungh giz senj vwnzgen Android gya haeuj ceiq lai 20 aen dozsiengq. Banj baih laj yienh’ok dozsiengq iq, mingz vwnzgen, gij cikconq laeng daet henz roxnaeuz gaij ciuq «Gvangq doxdoengz» roxnaeuz «Sang doxdoengz», caeuq seizgan coihgaij vwnzgen danghnaeuz giz hawj vwnzgen miz. Baiz ciuq mingz vwnzgen roxnaeuz seizgan coihgaij. Baiz neix mbouj gaij vih dozsiengq gaenq baij haenx.

Diemj aen dozsiengq iq daeuj senj de. «Daet henz dozsiengq» daet henz aen dozsiengq haenx. «Daet henz lai dozsiengq» daet henz gij dozsiengq senj haenx ciuq diap diemj saek dozsiengq roxnaeuz beijlaeh moix bak faenh. Rag giz gaemz daet henz roxnaeuz sij gij soq. «Caiq yungh daengx dozsiengq» hoizfuk gij henz yienzlaiz. Daet henz mbouj haih dozsiengq yienzlaiz, caeuq siu ndaej.

Gaemz aen dozsiengq iq, roxnaeuz rag aen dozsiengq gaenq youq ndaw dieg guhsaeh, caiq cuengq youq henz yienh’ok haenx. Gij yawj sien roengzdiemj haenx yienh’ok coh ciep laengde cinj. «Gvangq doxdoengz» caeuq «Sang doxdoengz» hawj dozsiengq haeuj haenx miz gij cikconq doxdoengz, hoeng moix aen lij baujlouz gij beijlaeh gvangq caeuq sang gag miz. Cij aeu aen dozsiengq senj haenx ok daj dieg baij, dauq youq banj baih laj. Dozsiengq wnq lij youq ndaw dieg baij; gij dozsiengq ciep giz de haenx hoengjlau yaek doengh daeuj ndaemh giz hoengq. «Rom PNG» cigciep rom dozsiengq buek liux haenx. «Youq Paint gaij» aeu de haeuj giz gaij cawj, vuenh aen dozsiengq seizneix; siu ndaej. Dangh dozsiengq moq yaek yungh RAM lai gvaq gij RAM hawj yungh, miz yienh’ok gij senj guh aen iq di haenx couh senj de. Dangh dozsiengq iq lai lij yaek yungh RAM lai gvaq, aen yonjgen yienh’ok gij cawqhoeng RAM, mbouj hawj senj cikconq. Vwnzgen laiyenz yienzlaiz mbouj bienq. Buek seizneix rom youq gihgi neix; mwh mwngz dauqdaeuj, buek gag hai.

Gij cienghcawj neix yungh gij Catrobat/AGPL caeuq gij mingz boux guh dozsiengq doxdoengz, yienh’ok youq giz gaij cawj ndaw «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh».

za/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.

za/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_bel.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

Rag dozsiengq iq roxnaeuz dozsiengq gaenq baij daeuj ciep youq baih gvaz, henz gwnz doxndaengz, roxnaeuz youq baih laj, henz swix doxndaengz. «Vih cinj» dingh gok gwnz baih swix ciuq cingjsoq diemj saek dozsiengq haidaeuz 0, mbouj hawj dozsiengq wnq doengh, caeuq hawj doxdep ndaej. Dozsiengq haeuj laeng haenx yienh’ok youq gwnz. Cij aeu dozsiengq senj haenx ok daj dieg baij. Dozsiengq wnq lij gaenq baij; gij dozsiengq ciep giz de hoengjlau yaek doengh daeuj ndaemh giz hoengq. «Yienh’ok sojmiz» gaij beijlaeh yawj. «Rom PNG» lingh rom buek dozsiengq; «Youq Paint gaij» aeu buek haeuj giz gaij, siu gij gaij de ndaej. Yonjgen yungh aen giz gaij dozsiengq mbouj roengzdiemj ndeu. Buek dozsiengq dwg dieg guhsaeh lingh miz daeuj baij dozsiengq.

Banj «Vwnzgen > Soqgawq AN Paint, gij hawj yungh caeuq boux guh» miz banjgienz yienzlaiz, mingz boux guh dozsiengq caeuq yiengh cih, gij saw hawj yungh daengx caeuq daengx gij daimaex laiyenz banj neix. Ringx gij saw hawj yungh mbouj hawj nauj «Lingh guh sojmiz daeuj nem», «Diuzgienh eiz» caeuq «Baenz le» doengh.

ch/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
ch/ui_help23.previous:
Atyik un tab para u fanmamostra i ramienta-ña. «Atan» tutuhun gi «Muebi i mostra»; gi «Dibuhu» guaha «Dibuhu», «Sileksión» yan «Na'hålum». «Muebi i mostra» ha muebi i mostra sin dibuhu. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom. I flecha gi fi'on i tab siha ha na'attuk i panel. Guaha na'an kada ramienta. Usa «Tulaika» para un tulaika i påtti ni ma'atyik, i kåntun brin, i mineddung, pat i pinenta.

Gi «Kulot» siña un atyik i kulot para un fa'tinas pinenta (FG) yan i kulot para i brin (BG). «Tulaika i lugåt i kulot siha» ha tulaika i lugåt i dos; «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu» ha na'ta'lu i dos na kulot. I ramienta para un atyik kulot ha na'annuk ensegidas i kulot ni un atyik. «Usa kulot» ha aksepta i inatyik; «Kansela» ha na'ta'lu i primet na kulot. Usa «Na'halom kulot» pat patcha un lugåt ni tåya' kulot para un atyik yan po'lu un kulot. Patcha ya go'ti un kulot ni mapo'lu para un tulaika pat na'suha. «Mås inatyik siha» gaigi gi fi'on «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu». Ha baba i editor ni guaha mås inatyik para i kulot.

«Råya siha gi kantun kada pixel» ha na'annuk lokkui' i regla para i pixels gi pinenta. Yanggin un usa i cursor para un fa'tinas pinenta, mamostra i lugåt-ña (X/Y) gi fi'on i zoom ya matulaika an mamuyi i cursor.

«Po'lu kumu…» para un atyik i klåsin dokumentu, i inatyik para u mafa'dikiki' i dokumentu, yan i lugåt para u mapo'lu. «Po'lu» ha po'lu ta'lu gi mesmu na lugåt yan i mesmu na inatyik siha. «Po'lu un sahngi na kopia…» ha fa'tinas un dokumentu ICO, un pinenta gi tinige' ASCII, pat un tinige' Base64; ti ha marka i dibuhu kumu mapo'lu. «Po'lu yan kumpåtti» ha po'lu un kopia, pues baba i inatyik Android para un kumpåtti. Ti matulaika i lugåt ni ma'usa på'gu para «Po'lu».

Gi «Dibuhu > Na'hålum > Otro siha na imåhen» guaha dokumentu ginin i tråstis, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart yan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapa siha ni tåya' tinige'…». I pinenta ni mana'hålum ma'atyik trabiha. Mamostra i go'tihan-ña maskeseha gaigi gi huyong i brin. «Tulaika i mineddung i pinenta para u hålum gi brin» ha tulaika i lugåt-ña gi brin; «Urihinåt na mineddong» ha na'ta'lu i mineddung i urihinåt na pinenta.

An un baba ta'lu i app, i autosave ha na'ta'lu i kopia para cho'chu' yan i rekot para un na'lo gi estådo åntis pat un rinueba i tinilaika. Gi «Dokumentu» guaha lokkui' «Dinanña' i pinenta siha», «Taimanu para un usa AN Paint» yan «Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas». Siña un na'hålum tinige' gi banda pat disdi sanhilu' asta sanpapa'.

ch/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
ch/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_s.previous:
Usa i ramientan Android para un atyik dokumentu ya na'hålum asta 20 na pinenta. Gi bandeha gi papa', mamostra i dikiki' na mostran kada pinenta, i na'an i dokumentu, yan i mineddung dispues di ma'atyik i påtti ni para u ma'usa yan dispues di maseha håfa na tinilaika ni mafa'tinas ni «Parehu na finedda'» pat «Parehu na attura». Mamostra lokkue' i fechan tinilaika yanggin ha na'i i sisteman dokumentu. Siña un na'arekla i bandeha sigun gi na'an pat i fechan tinilaika; ti mamomuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega esta.

Patcha un dikiki' na mostra para un atyik i pinenta. «Atyik i påtti gi pinenta para u ma'usa» para un tutot i oriyan ayu na pinenta. «Atyik i påtti para u ma'usa gi meggai na pinenta» para un tutot i oriyan i pinenta siha ni ma'atyik, gi pixels pat put sientu. Håla i go'tihan siha pat tugi' i numiru siha. «Atyik ta'lu enteru i pinenta» para u fanma'usa ta'lu i urihinåt na oriya. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu, ya siña un na'ta'lu i estådo åntis.

Go'ti un dikiki' na mostra pat håla un pinenta ni mapega esta, pues libera gi oriyan ni ma na'annuk. I mostra ni siña un li'e' i san papa'-ña ha na'annuk eksåktu i lugåt ni para u mapega. Yanggin mapega gi agapa', parehu i sanhilo' i dos na pinenta; yanggin mapega gi papa', parehu i akagui'. Siña lokkue' un patcha i dikiki' na mostra, pues patcha un siñåt +. An ma'usa esti na manera para u mapega i pinenta, i primet na pinenta tutuhun gi X=0, Y=0. Yanggin matutot i oriyan un pinenta, siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriya-ña. Ti masisedi na u matampe un pinenta ni ottru yanggin mapega gi oriya.

Atyik un pinenta ya usa «Eksåktu na lugåt» para un tugi' i X yan Y para i eskina sanhilo' gi akakgui. Intiru na pixels i X yan Y, disdi seru. Ti mamomuyi i ottru na pinenta siha. Siña matampe un pinenta ni ottru gi esti na manera.

«Parehu na finedda'» yan «Parehu na attura» ha na'parehu i mineddung ni ma'atyik para todu i pinenta siha, lao ha adahi i guinaha na proporsion kada pinenta. Atyik pixels, put sientu, «I mås dikiki'» pat «I mås dångkulu». «Na'ta'lu i urihinåt na mineddung siha» ha na'ta'lu i mineddung siha sin tulaika i inatyik i påtti siha ni para u ma'usa.

«Na'suha ginin i lugåt» ha na'ta'lu i pinenta ni ma'atyik ha' gi bandeha. I ottru na pinenta siha mapega trabiha; siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriyan ayu na pinenta para u matåmpi i bakånti. «Na'suha» ha lakngus ayu ha' na pinenta ginin i dinanña'. Siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis pat usa «Rinueba». Håla un pinenta ni mapega para un tulaika i lugåt-ña. Håla gi lugåt ni tåya' pinenta para un muebi i mostra. Na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom. «Na'annuk todu» ha tulaika i zoom para u mamostra todu i dinanña'; ti ha tulaika i mineddung i pinenta ni para u mahuyong.

«Po'lu PNG» ha po'lu i pinenta ni ginin i dinanña' direktu. «Tulaika gi Paint» ha na'hålum i dinanña' gi editor prinsipat kumu inalikun i brin; siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis. Yanggin ti nahung i RAM para i pinenta ni para u mahuyong, atyik un mås dikiki' na kopia yanggin mana'i hao este na inatyik. Yanggin ti nahung i RAM maskeseha dikiki' i pinenta, para u mamostra un atbisu put i RAM, ti un inatyik put i mineddung. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu siha. Mapo'lu i dinanña' gi tråstis ya mababa ta'lu an bumira hao.

Esti na manera ha usa i mesmu na kreditu para Catrobat/AGPL yan i ikonu, i klåsin lettra yan i pinenta siha ni mamostra gi editor prinsipat: «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas».

ch/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_bel.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

Atyik «Atan», «Dibuhu», «Dokumentu», «Tulaika» pat «Kulot» para u fanmamostra i ramientan ayu na tab. I flecha gi fi'on i tab siha ha na'attuk pat ha na'annuk ta'lu i panel. An mås takhilu' ki anchu i pantalla, i tab siha yan i linian ramienta gaigi gi banda; muebi i lista para un li'e' mås ramienta. An mås anchu ki takhilu' i pantalla, gaigi i tab siha yan i prinsipat na ramienta gi akagui', disdi sanhilo' para papa'. Gi «Dibuhu» guaha i gurupun «Dibuhu», «Sileksión» yan «Na'hålum». Gi gurupun «Dibuhu» gaigi i «Lapes», «Pensét», «Pensét (maya' i bånda; Watercolor)» yan «Rega kulot». «Sileksión» ha na'danña' i sileksión rektånggulu yan i sileksión ni un dibuhu i uriya-ña. «Na'hålum» ha na'danña' i råya, hechura yan tinige'. Patcha un gurupu para u ma'atyik i ramienta ni un usa uttimu gi gurupu, ya u fanmamostra i ramienta yan i inatyik gi papa' i linia an mås takhilu' ki anchu i pantalla, pat gi akat an mås anchu ki takhilu'. Patcha ta'lu i gurupu ni ma'atyik para un na'attuk pat na'annuk i ramienta yan i inatyik. Ha hahasso kada gurupu i uttimu na ramienta ni ma'usa disdi an mababa i app. Muebi i listan inatyik para un li'e' mås. Gi sanhilo' guaha i na'an i dokumentu yan i buton siha para i che'chu' ensegidas. Para i kreditu yan kondision, usa «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas».

Gi tab «Kulot» guaha i siñåt para i kulot para un fa'tinas pinenta (FG) yan i kulot para i brin (BG), «Tulaika i lugåt i kulot siha», «Na'åttilong yan na'å'paka' ta'lu» yan «Mås inatyik siha». Patcha i påttin FG pat BG gi siñåt para un tulaika ayu na kulot. I otdinåriu na paleta yan i kulot ni mapo'lu gaigi gi papa' i sanhilo' na panel. Patcha un kulot gi paleta para FG; patcha ya go'ti para BG. I kuåttru na lugåt gi achaflån akat i paleta ha adahi i kulot ni ma'usa gi halatcha; patcha para FG pat patcha ya go'ti para BG. Gi editor para kulot guaha «Paleta», «Paletan sais na kåntu» yan «Mås inatyik siha». Gi «Mås inatyik siha» guaha «Mostran kulot siha», «Rueda», RGB, HSV, HSL yan i kodigo hex ni sais na simbulu. I kulot ni mapo'lu gi tutuhun: Kulot lila ni mås å'paka' #5B67FF, Kulot oru #FFD700, Kulot salåppi' #C0C0C0 yan Kulot kopbli #B87333. Patcha un kulot ni mapo'lu para FG. Patcha ya go'ti para un atyik para BG, tulaika pat na'suha. «Na'halom kulot» pat un lugåt ni tåya' kulot ha baba i editor para un po'lu kulot. Tåya' transparensian i prinsipat na dokumentu. An mababa un pinenta ni guaha transparensia kumu brin, ma na'bula i påtti siha ni guaha transparensia ni kulot BG på'gu. Yanggin mana'hålum un pinenta, ma'atyik trabiha ya siña mamuyi; an ma cho'gui i inatyik, i brin ni guaha esta mamostra gi påtti siha ni guaha transparensia. I pinenta siha ginin Wikimedia Commons manmana'i å'paka' na kulot gi san papa'-ñiha åntis di mana'hålum. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu siha.

Gi «Atan > Muebi i mostra», håla ni un kålulot para un muebi i mostra; na'hihot pat na'chågu' i dos na kålulot para un tulaika i zoom, pat muebi i dos para un muebi i mostra. Atyik ta'lu «Dibuhu» gi inatyik «Muebi i mostra», pat atyik un ramientan dibuhu, para un dibuhu ta'lu. Siña lokkue' un muebi i mostra ni dos na kålulot an ma'atyik un ramientan dibuhu sin mafa'tinas ni un råya. I kontrol gi papa' akat guaha linia gi talu'-ña para 100%. I buton siha para un na'dångkulu pat na'dikiki' i mostra manpåra gi 100% yanggin para u maloffan ennåo na midida; patcha ta'lu para u kontinua. I buton «Na'annuk todu» gi fi'on ha na'annuk enteru i brin yan maseha håfa na påtti ni ma'atyik ni siña mamuyi, ya ha pega gi talu' i mostra. «Muebi i mostra» guaha lokkue' 100%; «Atan» guaha i råya siha gi kantun kada pixel.

I autosave ha po'lu i kopia para cho'chu' an mapåra un ratu i tinilaika pat an un huyong ginin i app. I siñåt put i estådo ha na'annuk na «Mapo'lu i kopia para cho'chu'» pat na guaha problema gi autosave. An un baba ta'lu i app, ma na'ta'lu i kopia para cho'chu', i na'an i dokumentu, i inatyik para i ramienta, i påtti ni ma'atyik ni siña mamuyi, yan i hechura siha ni ti munhåyan. I kopia para cho'chu' mapo'lu pribådu. Gi «Dokumentu» siña un po'lu PNG, JPEG yan HEIC ni siña un atyik i kualidåt-ñiha, yan JPEG XL, WebP yan AVIF ni siña mafa'dikiki' sin malingu detalye pat siña malingu palu na detalye. «Po'lu kumu…» para un atyik i klåsin dokumentu, i inatyik yan i lugåt; «Po'lu» ha po'lu ta'lu gi mesmu na lugåt. «Po'lu un sahngi na kopia…» yan «Po'lu yan kumpåtti» ha po'lu un kopia sin tulaika i lugåt para «Po'lu», ya ti ha marka i dibuhu kumu mapo'lu. «Po'lu yan kumpåtti» ha baba dispues i inatyik Android para un kumpåtti. I puti'on gi fi'on i na'an i dokumentu kumeke'ilek-ña guaha tinilaika ni ti mapo'lu. I autosave ti ha tulaika i urihinåt na dokumentun pinenta.

Sileksión: dibuhu un rektånggulu pat dibuhu i uriya gi hechura ni un malago'. Håla gi halom i påtti ni ma'atyik para un muebi; håla i kuådrådu na go'tihan gi eskina pat gi talu' un kåntu para un tulaika i mineddung, pat håla i ridondu na go'tihan para un bira. «Adahi i hechura» aktibu gi tutuhun; desaktiba para un tulaika i finedda' yan i attura sahngi. I go'tihan gi kåntu ha tulaika i mineddung gi ayu na banda. I påtti ni un dibuhu i uriya-ña ha adahi i hechura-ña gi halom i kahon para i tinilaika, maskeseha mabira pat mapo'lu ni autosave. Mamostra i mineddung yan i ånggulu gi panel para i inatyik. «Cho'gui i tinilaika gi påtti ni ma'atyik» ha usa i finakpo' na tinilaika; siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis, ya i autosave ha adahi i tinilaika ni ti munhåyan. «Kopia», «Utot» yan «Usa i påtti ni ma'atyik kumu brin» ma'usa i pinenta ni matulaika esta. I buton para un atyik todu gaigi gi «Tulaika > Sileksión»; Ctrl+A lokkue' machochu' gi teklådu ni ma na'danña' gi huyong. I buton «Utot», «Kopia» yan «Pega» gaigi gi sanhilo'. I maskaran sileksión ha adahi i hechuran i påtti ni ma'atyik. I dokumentu mismo tåya' transparensia.

Kåntun brin: håla i go'tihan siha para halom para un tutot, pat para huyong para un na'dångkulu maseha gi månu na banda. Pues usa «Usa i nuebu na kåntun brin». Ma'usa BG gi nuebu na kåmpu, ya ti matulaika i mineddung i pixels ni guaha esta. Siña un kansela pat na'lo gi estådo åntis. «Tulaika i mineddung i pinenta», «Mineddung i brin» yan «Nuebu na imåhen» siña un atyik Pixels pat Put sientu yan usa «Adahi i hechura» yanggin un malago'.

Kutba: dibuhu un råya pues håla dos biahi para un na'guaha dos na kutba. Poligonu: patcha kada punta, pues patcha dos biahi i uttimu na punta pat usa i buton para un na'funhåyan i hechura. Desaktiba «Na'danña' i uttimu na punta yan i primet na punta» para un fa'tinas tunas na råya siha ni mandanña' lao ti masera. Rektånggulo ni ridondu i iskina siha: usa i kontrol para i midida ginin i talu' asta i kantu (px); ti siña u mås dångkulu ki i metå gi mås kadada' na banda. Tinige': patcha i brin, atyik i klåsin lettra ni mamostra gi manera-ña, ya atan i mostra mientras un tulaika i tinige'. Siña un atyik i mineddung, «Potput», «Egging na lettra», «Råya gi papa' i lettra», råya gi talu' i lettra, «Lugåt i tinige'», «Distånsia gi entalu' i råya siha», yan kahon para tinige' ni kulot BG. «Pensét (maya' i bånda; Watercolor)» gaigi gi gurupun «Dibuhu», gi fi'on i Pensét yan Rega kulot; tulaika «Minetgut i kulot (%)» para un fa'tinas suåbi na råya. I kontrol para i mineddung i Lapes, Pensét yan ramienta siha asta 100 pixels. I Lapes tutuhun gi 1 pixel ya ha hahasso i finedda' antes. Patcha i numiru ni mamostra para un tugi' i eksåktu na mineddung. I Kurasón, Puti'un yan Fletcha siha ha usa i mesmu na inatyik put i råya gi uriya yan i kulot gi halom kumu i ottru na hechura. «Atan > Fa'tinas pinenta ni cursor» ha na'annuk i inatyik para un aktiba i cursor, i hechuran cursor yan i mostra ni mana'dångkulu. Håla para un pega i cursor gi lugåt-ña. Patcha i buton para dibuhu gi pantalla, pues håla para un muebi i cursor ya dibuhu. Patcha ta'lo para un påra. I inatyik para i pinsel yan i råya siha gaigi gi «Dibuhu», gi gurupun ramienta «Dibuhu». «Atan > Mostra para u mana'dångkulu i pinenta» para un aktiba i dinångkulun i cursor pat i puntan dibuhu, yan atyik kuåntu dångkulu i mostra. Gi inatyik para dibuhu siña lokkue' un usa «Na'suåbi i kåntun i pixels (anti-aliasing)» pat «Na'suåbi i råya siha ni madibuhu ni kannai». Guaha diesiunu na klåsin lettra ni madanña' gi app; gi «Lisensian i klåsin lettra siha» gaigi i kreditu yan todu i kondision-ñiha.

«Dokumentu > Baba i pinenta…» ha tahgui i brin ni pinenta ni un atyik gi ramientan Android. Gi «Dibuhu → Na'hålum → Otro siha na imåhen» siña un usa dokumentu ginin i tråstis, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart yan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapa siha ni tåya' tinige'…». Atyik un pinenta ginin i tråstis, pat baba i påhinan pinenta gi internet ya patcha «Usa i pinenta», para un na'hålum pinenta ni ma'atyik ya siña mamuyi. Gi «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas > Kreditu para i pinenta siha» mapo'lu i link ginin i orihin yan i notisia put i lisensia. Yanggin nahung i RAM, mababa i pinenta gi urihinåt na mineddung. Yanggin nisisåriu, mamostra i inatyik para i mineddung, i numirun pixels yan i RAM ni makatkulålo. Atyik i mineddung ni Pixels pat Put sientu; siña un usa «Adahi i hechura». Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu.

«Dokumentu > Dinanña' i pinenta siha» ha baba un sahngi na kåmpun cho'chu' para asta 20 na pinenta. Na'arekla i dikiki' na mostra sigun gi na'an i dokumentu pat i fechan tinilaika. Atyik i påtti para u ma'usa gi un pinenta pat meggai na pinenta. «Parehu na finedda'» pat «Parehu na attura» ha na'parehu i mineddung ni ma'atyik gi todu i pinenta, sin tulaika i proporsion kada pinenta. Håla un dikiki' na mostra pat un pinenta ni mapega esta para u mapega gi akat yan parehu i sanhilo', pat gi papa' yan parehu i akagui'. «Eksåktu na lugåt» ha pega i eskina sanhilo' gi akagui' ni intiru na pixels, disdi seru; ti mamomuyi i ottru na pinenta, ya siña u matampe un pinenta ni ottru. I pinenta ni mana'hålum dispues mamostra gi sanhilo'. «Na'suha ginin i lugåt» ha na'suha i pinenta ni ma'atyik ha' ginin i lugåt-ña; i ottru na pinenta siha mapega trabiha, lao siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriyan ayu na pinenta para u matåmpi i bakånti. «Na'annuk todu» ha tulaika i zoom. «Po'lu PNG» ha po'lu i pinenta ni ginin i dinanña'. «Tulaika gi Paint» ha na'hålum gi editor, ya siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis. Guaha unu ha' na editor para pinenta ni tåya' transparensia; i dinanña' i pinenta siha un sahngi na kåmpun cho'chu' para un na'arekla i pinenta siha.

Gi panel «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas» gaigi i direchun i urihinåt na fuma'tinas, i kreditu para i pinenta, ikonu yan klåsin lettra siha, todu i tinige' put lisensia yan todu i kodigo fuente para esti na bersión. Siña un muebi i tinige' put lisensia sin mamuyi «Kopia todu», «Ottru na kondision siha» yan «Munhåyan».

I maskaran sileksión ha adahi i hechuran i påtti ni ma'atyik. I dokumentu mismo tåya' transparensia.

Kåntun brin: håla i go'tihan siha para halom para un tutot, pat para huyong para un na'dångkulu maseha gi månu na banda. Pues usa «Usa i nuebu na kåntun brin». Ma'usa BG gi nuebu na kåmpu, ya ti matulaika i mineddung i pixels ni guaha esta. Siña un kansela pat na'lo gi estådo åntis. «Tulaika i mineddung i pinenta», «Mineddung i brin» yan «Nuebu na imåhen» siña un atyik Pixels pat Put sientu yan usa «Adahi i hechura» yanggin un malago'.

Kutba: dibuhu un råya pues håla dos biahi para un na'guaha dos na kutba. Poligonu: patcha kada punta, pues patcha dos biahi i uttimu na punta pat usa i buton para un na'funhåyan i hechura. Desaktiba «Na'danña' i uttimu na punta yan i primet na punta» para un fa'tinas tunas na råya siha ni mandanña' lao ti masera. Rektånggulo ni ridondu i iskina siha: usa i kontrol para i midida ginin i talu' asta i kantu (px); ti siña u mås dångkulu ki i metå gi mås kadada' na banda. Tinige': patcha i brin, atyik i klåsin lettra ni mamostra gi manera-ña, ya atan i mostra mientras un tulaika i tinige'. Siña un atyik i mineddung, «Potput», «Egging na lettra», «Råya gi papa' i lettra», råya gi talu' i lettra, «Lugåt i tinige'», «Distånsia gi entalu' i råya siha», yan kahon para tinige' ni kulot BG. «Pensét (maya' i bånda; Watercolor)» gaigi gi gurupun «Dibuhu», gi fi'on i Pensét yan Rega kulot; tulaika «Minetgut i kulot (%)» para un fa'tinas suåbi na råya. I kontrol para i mineddung i Lapes, Pensét yan ramienta siha asta 100 pixels. I Lapes tutuhun gi 1 pixel ya ha hahasso i finedda' antes. Patcha i numiru ni mamostra para un tugi' i eksåktu na mineddung. I Kurasón, Puti'un yan Fletcha siha ha usa i mesmu na inatyik put i råya gi uriya yan i kulot gi halom kumu i ottru na hechura. «Atan > Fa'tinas pinenta ni cursor» ha na'annuk i inatyik para un aktiba i cursor, i hechuran cursor yan i mostra ni mana'dångkulu. Håla para un pega i cursor gi lugåt-ña. Patcha i buton para dibuhu gi pantalla, pues håla para un muebi i cursor ya dibuhu. Patcha ta'lo para un påra. I inatyik para i pinsel yan i råya siha gaigi gi «Dibuhu», gi gurupun ramienta «Dibuhu». «Atan > Mostra para u mana'dångkulu i pinenta» para un aktiba i dinångkulun i cursor pat i puntan dibuhu, yan atyik kuåntu dångkulu i mostra. Gi inatyik para dibuhu siña lokkue' un usa «Na'suåbi i kåntun i pixels (anti-aliasing)» pat «Na'suåbi i råya siha ni madibuhu ni kannai». Guaha diesiunu na klåsin lettra ni madanña' gi app; gi «Lisensian i klåsin lettra siha» gaigi i kreditu yan todu i kondision-ñiha.

«Dokumentu > Baba i pinenta…» ha tahgui i brin ni pinenta ni un atyik gi ramientan Android. Gi «Dibuhu → Na'hålum → Otro siha na imåhen» siña un usa dokumentu ginin i tråstis, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart yan «Wikimedia Commons · Mapa siha ni tåya' tinige'…». Atyik un pinenta ginin i tråstis, pat baba i påhinan pinenta gi internet ya patcha «Usa i pinenta», para un na'hålum pinenta ni ma'atyik ya siña mamuyi. Gi «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas > Kreditu para i pinenta siha» mapo'lu i link ginin i orihin yan i notisia put i lisensia. Yanggin nahung i RAM, mababa i pinenta gi urihinåt na mineddung. Yanggin nisisåriu, mamostra i inatyik para i mineddung, i numirun pixels yan i RAM ni makatkulålo. Atyik i mineddung ni Pixels pat Put sientu; siña un usa «Adahi i hechura». Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu.

«Dokumentu > Dinanña' i pinenta siha» ha baba un sahngi na kåmpun cho'chu' para asta 20 na pinenta. Na'arekla i dikiki' na mostra sigun gi na'an i dokumentu pat i fechan tinilaika. Atyik i påtti para u ma'usa gi un pinenta pat meggai na pinenta. «Parehu na finedda'» pat «Parehu na attura» ha na'parehu i mineddung ni ma'atyik gi todu i pinenta, sin tulaika i proporsion kada pinenta. Håla un dikiki' na mostra pat un pinenta ni mapega esta para u mapega gi akat yan parehu i sanhilo', pat gi papa' yan parehu i akagui'. «Eksåktu na lugåt» ha pega i eskina sanhilo' gi akagui' ni intiru na pixels, disdi seru; ti mamomuyi i ottru na pinenta, ya siña u matampe un pinenta ni ottru. I pinenta ni mana'hålum dispues mamostra gi sanhilo'. «Na'suha ginin i lugåt» ha na'suha i pinenta ni ma'atyik ha' ginin i lugåt-ña; i ottru na pinenta siha mapega trabiha, lao siña mamuyi i pinenta siha ni mapega gi oriyan ayu na pinenta para u matåmpi i bakånti. «Na'annuk todu» ha tulaika i zoom. «Po'lu PNG» ha po'lu i pinenta ni ginin i dinanña'. «Tulaika gi Paint» ha na'hålum gi editor, ya siña un na'lo gi estådo åntis. Guaha unu ha' na editor para pinenta ni tåya' transparensia; i dinanña' i pinenta siha un sahngi na kåmpun cho'chu' para un na'arekla i pinenta siha.

Gi panel «Dokumentu > Put AN Paint, lisensia siha, yan håyi fuma'tinas» gaigi i direchun i urihinåt na fuma'tinas, i kreditu para i pinenta, ikonu yan klåsin lettra siha, todu i tinige' put lisensia yan todu i kodigo fuente para esti na bersión. Siña un muebi i tinige' put lisensia sin mamuyi «Kopia todu», «Ottru na kondision siha» yan «Munhåyan».

zgh/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.

ⵙⵜⵉ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ. ⵙⵎⵔⵙ «ⴰⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵉⵚⵃⴰⵏ» ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵖⵍⴷ X/Y ⵏ ⵜⵖⵎⵔⵜ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵖⵔ ⵓⵥⵍⵎⴰⴹ ⵙ ⵓⵟⵟⵓⵏ ⵓⵎⵎⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ ⵙⴳ 0. ⵜⵉⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⵢⴰⴹⵏ ⴷⴰ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏⵜ ⴳ ⵉⴷⵖⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ; ⵣⵎⵔⵏⵜ ⴰⴷ ⴳⵏⵜ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵅⴼ ⵢⴰⵜ.

«ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵉⵔⵉⵡⵜ» ⴷ «ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵉⵖⵣⵉ» ⴷⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵢⴰⵜ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵉ ⵜⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵯ. ⴽⵓ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⴷⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵥ ⵜⴰⵙⵙⴰⵖⵜ ⴳⵔ ⵜⵉⵔⵉⵡⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵖⵣⵉ ⵏⵏⵙ. ⵙⵜⵉ ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ, ⴰⴼⵎⵉⴹⵉ, «ⴰⵎⵥⵥⵢⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽ» ⵏⵉⵖ «ⴰⵎⵇⵇⵔⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽ». «ⵙⵙⵓⴽⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵜⵉⵏⴰⵚⵍⵉⵢⵉⵏ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽⴽⴰⵙ ⴰⵙⵎⵙⴰⵙⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ, ⵉⵇⵇⵉⵎ ⵓⴽⴽⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵉⵔⴰⵏ.

«ⴽⴽⵙ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴽⵓⵏ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵜⵢⵏ ⵖⴰⵙ ⵖⵔ ⵓⵎⵓⵖ. ⵜⵉⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⵢⴰⴹⵏ ⴷⴰ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏⵜ; ⵣⵎⵔⵏⵜ ⵜⵡⵍⴰⴼⵉⵏ ⵉⵣⴷⵉⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵎⵓⵜⵜⵉⵏⵜ ⴰⴷ ⴽⵜⵓⵔⵏⵜ ⴰⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵉⵅⵡⴰⵏ. «ⴽⴽⵙ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽⴽⴰⵙ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⴰ ⵖⴰⵙ. ⵣⵎⵔⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⵔⴷ ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⵓⴽⵏⴷ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⵍⵏ ⴰ. ⵊⴱⴷ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜ ⵜⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⵢⴷ; ⵊⴱⴷ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵉⵅⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⵢⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ. ⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⴱⴹⵓ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⴹⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵉⵎⵖⵓⵔ. «ⵙⵙⵓⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵯ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵙⵉⵎⵖⵓⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵯ; ⵓⵔ ⴷⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ.

«PNG: ⵃⴹⵓ» ⴷⴰ ⵉⵃⵟⵟⵓ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵎⵓⵏⵏ ⵏⵉⵛⴰⵏ. «ⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⴳ Paint» ⴷⴰ ⵜⵜ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⵖⵔ ⵓⵎⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⴰⴷⵙⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ; ⵜⵣⵎⵔⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⵔⴷ ⴰⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⴰ. ⵎⴽ ⵉⵣⵔⵉ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵙⵜ ⵏ RAM, ⵙⵜⵉ ⵜⵓⵏⵖⵉⵍⵜ ⵉⵎⵥⵉⵏ ⵅⴼ ⵜⴰ ⵎⴽ ⵜⵍⵍⴰ. ⵎⴽ ⵉⵣⵔⵉ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⴼⵖ ⴰⵎⵥⵥⵢⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵙⵜ ⴰ, ⵔⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵏ AN Paint ⴰⵍⵖⵓ ⵅⴼ RAM ⴱⵍⴰ ⴰⵙⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ. ⵉⴼⵓⵢⵍⴰ ⵉⵏⴰⵚⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ ⴱⵍⴰ ⴰⵙⵏⴼⵍ. ⵉⵜⵜⵡⴰⵃⴹⴰ ⵓⵙⵎⵓⵏ ⴳ ⵓⵍⵍⴰⵍ ⴰ, ⵔⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵥⵎ ⴷⵉⵖ ⵎⴽ ⴷ ⵜⵓⵖⵓⵍⴷ.

zgh/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.

zgh/ui_help23.reason: Uses a single long press on saved colours; names tab and categories separately while keeping exact identical labels.

zgh/ui_the_arrow_on_the_left_directly_be.source:
Choose View, Draw, File, Edit or Color to show that tab's controls. The arrow beside the tabs collapses or restores the panel. In portrait, the tabs and tool strip run horizontally; scroll them to reach more controls. In landscape, the tabs and primary tools run down the left. Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Drawing groups Pencil, Brush, Watercolor and Airbrush. Selection groups rectangular and free-form selections. Insert groups lines, shapes and text. Tap a category to select its remembered tool and show its tools and settings below the strip in portrait, or to its right in landscape. Tap the selected category again to collapse or expand its tools and settings. Categories remember the tool last used in them during the session. Scroll the options panel for further settings. The header contains the filename and quick actions. Credits & terms: «File > About, licences & credits».

The Color tab contains the FG/BG colour indicator, Swap colors, Black / white and Advanced. Tap the foreground or background part of the indicator to edit that colour. The standard palette and saved colours are below the header. Tap a standard swatch for foreground or hold for background. The four cells at the far right of the standard palette keep recent colours; tap for foreground or hold for background. The colour editor has Palette, Honeycomb and Advanced. Advanced has spectrum, wheel, RGB, HSV, HSL and six-digit hex controls. Custom colours start with Pale Violet #5B67FF, Gold #FFD700, Silver #C0C0C0 and Copper #B87333. Tap a saved colour to use it as foreground; hold it to choose background, edit or remove it. Add colour or an empty saved slot opens the editor to save a colour. The main document is opaque. Loading a transparent image as the canvas fills its transparent areas with the current BG colour. An inserted image remains a floating selection; its transparent areas reveal the existing canvas when committed. Wikimedia Commons imports receive a white backing before insertion. Original source files are unchanged.

View > Navigate: drag with one finger to pan, pinch with two fingers to zoom and pan. Choose Draw again in the Navigate options, or select a drawing tool, to return to drawing. Two-finger navigation also works in drawing tools without leaving paint marks. The bottom-right slider has a centre line at 100%. Zoom in/out buttons stop at 100% when a step would cross it; press again to continue. The adjacent Fit button fits and centres the canvas and any floating selection in the view. Navigate also provides 100%; View provides a pixel grid.

Autosave records the current draft after a short editing pause, and when you leave the app. The status shows Draft saved or an autosave error. Reopening restores the draft, filename, tool settings, floating selection and unfinished geometry. Autosave keeps a private working draft. File offers PNG, adjustable-quality JPEG and HEIC, and lossless or lossy JPEG XL, WebP and AVIF. Save as chooses the image format, settings and location; Save writes there again. Export as and Save and share write a copy without changing the current Save destination or marking the drawing saved. Save and share then opens Android sharing. The filename star means the drawing has unsaved changes. Source images are never overwritten by autosave.

Selections: draw a rectangle or free-form outline. Drag inside to move, drag a square corner or edge midpoint to resize, or drag the round Rotate handle to rotate. Lock proportions is on by default; switch it off to stretch width and height independently. Edge handles resize along the selected side. Free-form selections keep their selected shape within the transform box, including after rotation and autosave. The dimensions and angle appear in the options panel. Commit selection applies the result; selection edits can be undone, and autosave retains unfinished transforms. Copy, Cut and Crop to selection use the transformed image. Select all is under Edit > Selection, and Ctrl+A works on an external keyboard. Cut, Copy and Paste are quick actions in the header. Selection masks preserve the selected shape; the document itself remains opaque.

Canvas bounds: drag handles inward to trim or outward to expand on any side, then Apply bounds. New space uses BG; existing pixels are not scaled. Cancel and Undo are available. Resize image, Canvas size and New image also accept Pixels or Percent with an optional aspect lock.

Curve: draw a line and drag twice to bend it. Polygon: tap vertices, then double-tap the final vertex or use Finish polygon. Switch off Close polygon to draw connected open segments. Rounded rectangle: set Radius (px) with its slider; each shape limits the radius to half its shorter side. Text: tap the canvas, choose a font displayed in its own style and use the live preview. Options include size, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, alignment, line spacing and a BG text box. Watercolor is in the Drawing category beside Brush and Airbrush; adjust strength for softer strokes. Pencil, brush and tool size sliders go up to 100 pixels. Pencil starts at 1 pixel and remembers its own width. Tap the displayed number for exact numeric entry. Heart, Star and Arrow have the same outline/fill choices as other shapes. View > Cursor drawing expands its enable switch, cursor shape and magnifier settings. Drag to position the cursor, tap the on-screen drawing button, then drag to move the cursor and draw. Tap again to stop drawing. Brush and stroke settings remain under Draw > Drawing. View > Magnifier lets you enable a magnified preview of the cursor or drawing point and adjust its magnification. Drawing settings also offers antialiasing and stroke smoothing. Eleven additional fonts are bundled; Font licences has their credits and full terms.

File > Load image replaces the canvas through Android's picker. «Draw → Insert → Other images» provides device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Choose a device image, or open an online artwork page and tap «Use image», to add an image as a floating selection. File > About, licences & credits > Image credits keeps the source links and licence notice. Images within the device memory budget load at original resolution. If needed, a resize-choice dialog shows dimensions, pixel count and memory estimates, with Pixels/Percent sizing and optional aspect lock. The original file stays unchanged.

«File» > Image assembly opens a separate workspace for up to 20 images. Sort thumbnails by filename or time. Crop one image or batch-crop several. Same width / Same height normalizes all loaded images while preserving aspect ratios. Drag thumbnails or placed images to snap right/top aligned or bottom/left aligned. Exact position sets the top-left corner in whole pixels starting at zero, keeps other images fixed and permits overlaps. Images imported later are drawn on top. Unplace removes just the selected placement. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. «Show all» adjusts the view zoom. Save PNG exports the assembly; Edit in Paint transfers it as an undoable edit. The app uses one opaque image editor. Image assembly is a separate arrangement workspace.

The «File > About, licences & credits» panel includes original copyright, asset/font credits, full licence text and this version's complete source. Licence text scrolls independently of the fixed Copy all, Other terms and Done buttons.

nhe/gallery_description.source: Tap Use image to insert immediately. Copy credit beside an image copies its title, publisher, source and licence for your publication. Catrobat's original artwork is CC BY-SA 4.0; keep any separately named creators, copyright and other source notices. Describe your edits and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence. Edit credits lets you add these details; inserted sources remain under File → About, licences & credits → Image credits.
nhe/gallery_description.previous: Xictequihui «Xictequihui ni ixcopincayotl» para ticcalactiz nimantzin. Campa eltoc inacas ixcopincayotl tlen ica ticcopinaz, mocopina itoca, acquiya quimanextih, campa mocui huan licencia para tlen ticmanextiz. Ixcopincayotl tlen Catrobat quichijqui achtohui quitequihuiaj CC BY-SA 4.0. Xiccahua inintoca acquiya quichijque tlen moijtoaj ihiyoca, derechos de autor, huan ocsequi tlahcuiloliztli campa mocui. Xiquijcuilo tlen ticpatlac huan xictitlani ixcopincayotl tlen ticpatlac ica CC BY-SA 4.0 zo ceyoc licencia tlen hueli motequihuia san sejco. Campa ticpatla tlahcuiloliztli tlen quimanextia acquiya quichijqui hueli tictlalia ni tlahcuiloliztli. Campa mocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactih mocahua pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl → Tlen quimanextia acquiya quichiuhqui ixcopincayotl».

Ixcopincayotl tlen Catrobat quichijqui achtohui quitequihuiaj CC BY-SA 4.0. Xiccahua inintoca acquiya quichijque tlen moijtoaj ihiyoca, derechos de autor, huan ocsequi tlahcuiloliztli campa mocui. Xiquijcuilo tlen ticpatlac huan xictitlani ixcopincayotl tlen ticpatlac ica CC BY-SA 4.0 zo ceyoc licencia tlen hueli motequihuia san sejco. Ica «Xicpatla nopa información campa huala ixcopincayotl» hueli tictlalia ni tlahcuiloliztli. Campa mocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactih mocahua pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl → Acquiya quichiuhqui ixcopincayotl huan canin mocui».
nhe/gallery_description.reason: Names both repaired credit controls, keeps all copied fields, and quotes the independently checked existing File path.

nhe/ui_help23.source: Choose a tab to show its controls. View starts with Navigate; Draw contains Drawing, Selection and Insert. Navigate pans without drawing; pinch with two fingers to zoom. The arrow beside the tabs collapses the panel. All tools have labels. Edit changes the selection, canvas bounds, dimensions or image. Color selects foreground and background colors; Swap colors exchanges them and Black / white resets them. The color picker previews your choice immediately. Use colour confirms it; Cancel restores the previous color. Add colour or tap an empty saved slot to choose and save a colour. Hold a saved colour to edit or remove it. Advanced opens the detailed editor beside Black / white. Pixel grid also shows image-pixel rulers; cursor drawing shows live x/y beside zoom. Save as chooses an image format, compression settings and location; Save writes there again using those settings. Export as creates ICO, ASCII art or Base64 text without marking the drawing saved. Save and share saves a copy, then opens Android sharing. It keeps your current Save destination. Draw > Insert > Other images contains device files, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart and “Wikimedia Commons · Blank maps…”. Inserted images remain selected; the view shows their handles even outside the canvas. Fit image to canvas changes placement; Original size restores the source dimensions. Autosave restores the draft and both undo/redo stacks when you reopen the app. File also contains image assembly, How to use, and About, licences & credits. Insert text supports horizontal and vertical writing.
nhe/ui_help23.previous: Xictlapehpeni ce pestana para tiquittaz tlen hueli ticchihuaz. «Xiquitta» pehua ica «Xictotoxo ixcopincayotl para tiquittaz»; pan «Xicpa» oncah tlen hueli ica titlapa, «Xictlapehpeni» huan «Xictlali». Tlan zan tictotoxoa para tiquittaz, ax titlapa. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. Mitl tlen eltoc ininacas pestanas quitzacua campa neci tlen hueli ticchihuaz. Nochi tlen ica titequiti quipiya itoca. «Xicpatla» quipatla tlen tictlapehpenqui, inepamitl campa titlapa, ihuexca zo ixcopincayotl. «Ixnezcayotl» quipiya ixnezcayotl tlen mocahua iixpan huan iica; «Xicpatla iixpan huan iica» quincuepa, huan «Zampa xictequihui yayahuic / chipahuac» zampa quintlalia. Nimantzin neci ixnezcayotl tlen tictlapehpenia. «Xictequihui ni ixnezcayotl» quicahua nopa ixnezcayotl; tlan ticcahua ni tequitl, zampa mocahua ixnezcayotl tlen achtohui. «Xicahcocui ixnezcayotl» zo xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce lugar tlen axquipiya ixnezcayotl para tictlapehpeniz huan ticahcocuiz ce ixnezcayotl. Xiccahua momahpil pan ce ixnezcayotl tlen quiahcoucqui AN Paint para ticpatlaz zo ticquixtiz. «Achi miac tlen hueli ticpatlaz», inacas yayahuic / chipahuac, quitlapoa campa hueli ticpatlaz ocsequi tlen quipiya ixnezcayotl. «Inepamitl cehce pixel» noihqui quimanextia reglas ica pixels; quemman titlapa ica cursor, neci x/y campa eltoc namantzin inacas tlen quipatla quen huei neci ixcopincayotl. «Xicahcocui» hueli quicahua tictlapehpeniz tlamantli amatl, quen ticpitzahuaz huan campa ticahcocuiz; tlan zan ticahcocui zampa, quintequihuia nopa tlen tictlapehpenqui. Tlan ticquixtia ce copia, AN Paint quichihua ICO, ixcopincayotl ica ASCII zo tlahcuilolli Base64, zan axquimanextia quen ixcopincayotl tlen ya quiahcoucqui. «Xicahcocui huan xictitlani» quiahcocui ce copia, teipan quitlapoa campa Android quititlani; axquipatla campa ticahcocui namantzin. Pan «Xicpa → Xictlali → Cequinoc ixcopincayotl» oncah amatl tlen dispositivo, Catrobat, Irasutoya, Openclipart huan «Wikimedia Commons · Tlaltlachiyaliztli tlen axquipiya tlahcuilolli…». Ixcopincayotl tlen ticcalactia mocahua tlapehpentoc; neci campa hueli tiquihcuenia, noihqui tlan eltoc quiyahuac campa titlapa. Tlan tictlalia ixcopincayotl ma eli iihtic campa titlapa, mopatla campa eltoc; «Ihuexca tlen achtohui» zampa quicahua quen eltoya ihuexca. Tlen AN Paint quiahcocui icelti zampa mocahua quemman zampa tictlapoa, huan hueli tictequihuia «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» ica tlen eltoya achtohui. «Amatl» noihqui quipiya tlatecpanilli tlen ixcopincayotl, quen tictequihuiz AN Paint huan «Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl». Tlan tictlalia tlahcuilolli, hueli tictlalia tlen iarrabez hasta inemah zo tlen itzonco hasta itzintlan.

nhe/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.source:
Add up to 20 images with Android's file picker. The bottom tray shows thumbnails, filenames, image dimensions after cropping and any Same width or Same height adjustment, and file modification times when supplied by the provider. Sort by filename or modification time; sorting does not rearrange placed images.

Tap a thumbnail to select it. Crop image trims that image; Batch crop applies pixel or percentage margins to selected images. Drag crop handles or type amounts. Reset crop restores the original edges. Cropping is non-destructive and can be undone.

Hold a thumbnail, or drag an image already in the workspace, then drop it onto a highlighted edge. The translucent preview shows the exact snapped result. A right attachment aligns the tops; a bottom attachment aligns the left edges. You can also tap a thumbnail and then a + target. When snapping, the first image starts at the origin. Attached images may move when their parent is cropped. Overlaps are rejected when snapping.

Select an image and use Exact position to set its top-left X/Y coordinates in whole pixels, starting at zero. Other images keep their positions, and overlaps are allowed.

Same width and Same height give every input a common dimension while preserving each image's own aspect ratio. Choose pixels, percent, Smallest or Largest. Restore original sizes removes normalization and keeps crops.

Unplace returns only the selected image to the tray. Other images stay placed; attached images may move to fill the gap. Remove deletes only that input. Undo/Redo restore these changes. Drag a placed image to rearrange it; empty-space dragging pans. Pinch to zoom. «Show all» adjusts the zoom to show the whole assembly; it never changes output dimensions.

Save PNG saves the assembled image directly. Edit in Paint transfers it into the main editor as an undoable replacement. If the output exceeds the memory budget, choose a smaller output copy if offered. If even a tiny output exceeds the budget, the app shows a memory warning instead of a size chooser. Original source files stay unchanged. The current assembly is stored locally and reopens when you return.

This mode uses the same Catrobat/AGPL and asset credits shown in the main editor's «File > About, licences & credits» panel.
nhe/ui_add_up_to_20_images_with_android_.previous:
Xictlali hasta 20 ixcopincayotl ica campa Android mitzchihualtia xictlapehpeni amatl. Itzintlan neci ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzitzi, inintoca amatl, ihuexca ixcopincayotl satepan tlen tictequi huan tlen ticpatla ica «San ce ipatlauhca» zo «San ce ihuahcapanyo», huan quemman quipatlaque amatl tlan quitemaca nopa tlahcuiloliztli campa ticcui amatl. Xiquintecpana ica inintoca amatl zo quemman quipatlaque. Ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih axmoolinia.

Xictlali huan nimantzin xicquixti momahpil pan ce ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin para tictlapehpeniz. «Xictequi ixcopincayotl» quitequi san nopa ixcopincayotl; tlan tiquintequi miac san ce huelta, hueli tictlalia quezqui pixels zo por ciento ticquixtiz pan itenno cehce ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui. Xictotoxo campa hueli tiquihcuenia itenno zo xiquihcuilo quezqui ticquixtiz. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya itenno» zampa quicahua itenno quen eltoya. Tlan tictequi, axquipatla amatl tlen achtohui, huan hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya.

Xiccahua momahpil ce tlatoctzin pan ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin, zo xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih; xiccahua pan itenno tlen neci ocachi. Campa neci ixcopincayotl quen hueli titlachia iica, tiquitta canin mochijtoc tlan mopepechoa. Tlan mopepechoa pan inemah, motlalia san ce campa itzonco; tlan mopepechoa itzintlan, motlalia san ce campa iarrabez. Noihqui hueli xictlapehpeni ixcopincayotl cuecuetztzin huan teipa +. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, tlen achtohui pehua pan (0, 0). Tlan tictequi ixcopincayotl campa mopepechojtoque ocsequi, nopa ocsequi hueli moolinia. Tlan mopepechoa ixcopincayotl, axhueli mocahua ce ixcopincayotl ipan ceyoc.

Xictlapehpeni ce ixcopincayotl huan xictequihui campa hueli tictlalia melahuac para tictlaliz X/Y tlen itzonco iarrabez, ica pixels enteros tlen pehua pan 0. Ocsequi ixcopincayotl mocahua campa eltoya, huan hueli mocahua ce ipan ceyoc.

«San ce ipatlauhca» huan «San ce ihuahcapanyo» quintlalia nochi ixcopincayotl san ce ipatlauhca zo ihuahcapanyo, zan cehce quicahua quen eltoya ipatlauhca ica ihuahcapanyo. Xictlapehpeni pixels, por ciento, tlen ocachi cuecuetztzin zo tlen ocachi huei. Xiccuepa ihuexca tlen achtohui para nochi occepa quipiya ihuexca tlen eltoya, zan mocahua tlen tictequi.

Tlan tiquihcuenia, san ixcopincayotl tlen tictlapehpenqui mocuepa itzintlan. Ocsequi mocahua campa eltoya; tlen mopepechtoque hueli moolinia para quitemitiz campa polihui. Tlan ticquixtia, san nopa ixcopincayotl mopohpohua. «Zampa xiccahua quen eltoya» huan «Zampa xicchihua» quicuepa tlen mopatlac. Xictotoxo ce ixcopincayotl tlen ya tictlalih para tiquihcueniz; xictotoxo campa axoncah ixcopincayotl para tihcueniz tlen tiquitta. Ica ome momahpil xicnechco zo xiciyocatlali para ma neci maz huei zo maz cuecuetztzin. «Xiquitta nochi» quipatla quen huei neci para ma tiquitta nochi nopa tlatecpanilli; axquipatla ihuexca ixcopincayotl tlen AN Paint quichihuaz.

«Xicahcocui (PNG)» quiahcocui nopa ixcopincayotl tlatecpanilli. «Xicpatla pan Paint» quihuica campa titequiti para quipatla ixcopincayotl tlen eltoya; hueli zampa ticcahua quen eltoya. Tlan monequi ocachi RAM que tlen hueli motequihuia, xictlapehpeni ce copia maz cuecuetztzin tlan hueli. Tlan ce copia tlahuel cuecuetztzin noihqui monequi ocachi RAM, AN Paint mitzilhuiya axahci RAM, axmitzmanextia campa tictlapehpeniz ihuexca. Amatl tlen achtohui axmopatlaj. Tlatecpanilli mocahua pan ni dispositivo huan zampa motlapoa quemman timochicuepa.

Nican motequihuia sa no nopa Catrobat/AGPL huan tlahcuiloliztli tlen quimanextia acquiya quichijqui tlen motequihuia, quen neci campa titequiti pan «Amatl → Tlahcuiloliztli tlen AN Paint, licencias huan acquiya quichiuhqui ni tequitl».
